provenance.notes: Datasheet: KEMET C1059 'Radial, Molded, X7R Dielectric, 50-200 VDC' (8/21/2023), C052 style (0.20 in lead spacing), part C052K104K5R5CA = 0.1 µF, 50 V, X7R. Table 1A p.4 lists 0.1 µF (code 104) at 50 V. Dimension table p.2: C05X length 4.83±0.25, height 4.83±0.25, thickness 2.29±0.25, lead spacing 5.08±0.38, lead diameter 0.635 (+0.102/-0.051), lead length min 31.75 mm. Electrical table p.3: X7R capacitance change ±15% over -55 to +125 °C (tccMax 0.15) and dissipation factor max 2.5% for 50 V to 250 V parts (dfMax 0.025). Overview p.1: tolerances ±10% and ±20%, capacitance offerings 10 pF to 3.3 µF and voltage ratings 50, 100 and 200 V (these set the property limits). Kit: the component list image shows 'Capacitor 104 x4', which is 10 x 10^4 pF = 100 nF, hence the 1e-7 F default. The kit photo shows orange coated disc capacitors, whose dielectric (X7R, Y5V or Z5U), voltage and dimensions are not stated by SunFounder; the KEMET molded X7R part is a documented reference with the same 0.1 µF, 50 V rating and the common 5.08 mm lead spacing. Spans: the native lead spacing is 5.08±0.38 mm (2 pitches), so minSpan is 2. Bending the leads to 1 pitch is not covered by the datasheet. maxSpan 20 = floor((5.08 + 2 x (31.75 - 8)) / 2.54); the 8 mm per lead bend/insertion allowance is a modelling assumption, not a datasheet value. bodyMm is [length, thickness, height] at nominal drawing size.
